title: The Judgment Against Nineveh
description: A powerful prophetic judgment against the city of bloodshed, Nineveh. The prophet Nahum describes the city's violence, deceit, and sorcery, proclaiming the Lord's sentence of judgment. Nineveh is compared to No-Amon (Thebes), which fell earlier despite its strength, while the city's fortifications, merchants, and officers are depicted as powerless locusts. Finally, the downfall of Assyria's king is proclaimed—the wound is fatal.
